hypothesis: A LoRA adapter trained for more epochs (epoch 6) should produce better question quality by learning more signal from the training pairs — we expected further fine-tuning to push quality above earlier adapter checkpoints.
technique: A single greedy on-device call using a LoRA adapter checkpoint at epoch 6 (adapter_final), with no guided schema or post-processing — testing whether longer training improves or overfits the adapter.
result: Scored 0.307 on dev-10 (0 wins / 1 tie / 8 losses vs Sonnet), the worst result recorded and exactly as predicted for an overfit checkpoint; rubric showed coverage and non-redundancy at 3 with atomicity and naturalness at 4, but specPass of 90% could not compensate for poor coverage. Discarded — the hypothesis was falsified; epoch 6 overfit and regressed below earlier checkpoints.
label: adapter_final
